scripts.title: Get Every Gubbys
scripts.script:
local a = nil
local b = workspace.ToFind
local c = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character or game.Players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
repeat task.wait() until c:FindFirstChild"Head"

for i, v in next, b:GetChildren() do
if v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA"TouchTransmitter" then
firetouchinterest(v, c.Head, 1)
firetouchinterest(v, c.Head, 0)
end
end

repeat task.wait(.01)
fireclickdetector(workspace.Buttons.Button1)
fireclickdetector(workspace.Buttons.Button2)
fireclickdetector(workspace.Buttons.Button3)
until b["Asteroid Gubby"].CanTouch == true
firetouchinterest(b["Asteroid Gubby"], c.Head, 1)
firetouchinterest(b["Asteroid Gubby"], c.Head, 0)
